title: MediaTailor Monetization Function recipe metadata
description: Schema for recipe.yaml, the metadata file describing a single recipe.

id.description: Kebab-case recipe identifier. Must match the recipe folder name.

name.description: Human-readable recipe name, as shown in the MediaTailor console.

consoleRecipeId.description: The recipe id used by the MediaTailor console, for traceability when the repo folder name differs.

description.description: One-paragraph summary of what the recipe does.

services.description: External/AWS services and the function primitive the recipe uses (Axis 2).

hook.description: The lifecycle hook this recipe is intended to be attached to.

functionType.description: The MediaTailor function type used by this recipe.

tier.description: L1 = direct function definition; L2 = representative compiled output from a console design form.

documentationUrl.description: Primary reference documentation for the recipe or its integrated service.

requiredReplacements.description: Map of human-readable field label to the placeholder literal that must be replaced in function.json before deploying.
